# ClientLedger shortcuts (one page)

**File**

- `Ctrl+O` Open or Switch Company
- `Ctrl+P` Print
- `Ctrl+F4` Close Window
- `Ctrl+Q` Quit ClientLedger

**Edit**

- `Ctrl+Z` Undo
- `Ctrl+Y` Redo
- `Ctrl+F` Find / Go To
- `Ctrl+E` Edit Transaction
- `Ctrl+L` Open List for This Field
- `Ctrl+,` Preferences

**Lists**

- `Ctrl+A` Chart of Accounts

**Customers**

- `Ctrl+I` Create Invoice
- `Ctrl+R` Receive Payment
- `Ctrl+Shift+R` Sales Receipt

**Vendors**

- `Ctrl+B` Enter Bill
- `Ctrl+Shift+B` Pay Bills
- `Ctrl+W` Write Check
- `Ctrl+Shift+C` Record Card Charge

**Banking**

- `Ctrl+G` Open Register
- `Ctrl+D` Make Deposit
- `Ctrl+T` Transfer Funds
- `Ctrl+Shift+E` Reconcile

**Reports**

- `Ctrl+Shift+T` Trial Balance

**Company**

- `Ctrl+J` Make Journal Entry

**Window**

- `Alt+H` Home
- `Ctrl+Tab` Next Window
- `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` Previous Window
- `Ctrl+Shift+O` Move Window to Its Own Window
- `Ctrl++` Zoom In
- `Ctrl+-` Zoom Out
- `Ctrl+0` Actual Size
- `Ctrl+Shift+L` Switch Light, Dark, or Automatic Colors

**Help**

- `Ctrl+K` Go to
- `F1` Help for This Screen
- `Ctrl+/` Keyboard Shortcuts

**Forms and grids**

- `Alt+N` Save & New
- `Alt+S` Save & Close
- `Esc` Revert Field, Then Form
- `Page Down` Next Record
- `Page Up` Previous Record
- `Ctrl+Insert` Insert Line
- `Ctrl+Delete` Delete Line
- `Ctrl+D` Delete Transaction
- `Ctrl+M` Save as Template
- `Ctrl+N` New List Entry
- `Ctrl+Shift+I` Make Inactive or Active Again
- `Ctrl+Shift+H` Include Inactive Entries
- `Ctrl+Shift+Q` Account or Transaction Report

**Dates**: `+ / -` Next / previous day; `T` Today; `M / H` First / last day of the month; `Y / R` First / last day of the year; `W / K` First / last day of the week
